subject: Recap + modeled invoice range — Stellarnet pilot (tokens, $/1M targets)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Eliza Barnes <eliza@stellarnet.io>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@stellarnet.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Recap + modeled invoice range — Stellarnet pilot (tokens, $/1M targets)

Hi Eliza / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the modeled invoice artifacts I promised. I attached a working spreadsheet and a one-page estimate. High-level assumptions used in the model: 

- Inference profile: ~250M inference tokens/month (bursting to 1B on peak campaigns), average request length 120 tokens, tail 1% up to 2k tokens.
- Model family: Llama2-70B variant with quantization Q4_0 for the pilot (we also modeled an L70B-int8 path).
- Serving mode: Hosted API for pilot (we included a Dedicated capacity option in the sheet for reference).
- Target SKU economics: customer target ~ $125 / 1M inference tokens (we tested target ranges $120–$180).

Attached: stellarnet_token_model_v1.xlsx (tabbed: volume_brackets, unit_econ, discount_scenarios) and redwood_estimate_Stellarnet_v1.pdf (one-page invoice-range).

What I’d like from you as next steps so we can finalize a formal quote: 
1) Confirm the expected monthly token band (pick one): A) 100–300M B) 300–700M C) 700M–1.2B
2) Preferred pilot length: 30 / 90 / 180 days and whether you want a committed commit (we modeled 3- and 6-months).
3) Procurement timeline and if procurement requires a 30-day PO or a signed DocuSign.

Notes on the model (short): unit economics shown in the spreadsheet include per-token serving runtime, storage for KV cache, network egress estimate, and a 6% platform fee for observability + SLOs. Discount tiers in the sheet are applied to the hosted list rate; Dedicated pricing is included as a separate tab with reserved GPU pool assumptions.

If it helps, I can generate a line-item invoice (PDF) with the exact discount scenario you prefer — say a 6-month committed pilot at a 15% committed-volume discount.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Thanks Aditya — good recap and the attachments look useful. A couple quick notes from our side after reviewing with product & finance: 

- Budget target: Finance is pushing for a target in the neighborhood of $120–$130 / 1M tokens for the pilot. Their preferred internal target is $125 / 1M.
- Volume note: our initial safe-band is 300–500M/mo for the first 90 days; we expect spikes up to ~900M during a marketing push.
- Procurement: procurement@stellarnet.io will need a PDF invoice and a short SOW. They typically process a 30-day PO.

Can you provide a line-item invoice estimate (PDF) showing: list rate, compute + infra markup, applied discount for a 6-month pilot (500M committed / month), and net $/1M? If you can show two scenarios — Hosted (pay-as-you-go with volume discounts) and Dedicated (reserved) — that would be ideal.

I’ve attached our RFP summary (Stellarnet_RFP_Q3.pdf) to this thread. If you need an initial PO for budgeting, procurement can issue a non-binding estimate PO.

Eliza Barnes

Date: 2026-08-23T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Stellarnet — Hosted vs Dedicated invoice estimate (attached)

Hi Eliza / Rajiv —

Attached is a short invoice-range PDF (redwood_estimate_Stellarnet_v1.pdf) and the detailed model workbook (stellarnet_token_model_v1.xlsx). Summary of the two scenarios (numbers rounded):

Scenario A — Hosted (pay-as-you-go with commit discount):
- List hosted rate (baseline): $160 / 1M tokens
- Infrastructure & egress estimate: $26 / 1M (inc. KV cache amortized, networking, observability)
- Platform & ops margin: $14 / 1M
- Net before discount: $200 / 1M
- Applied discount examples: 10% (3-month commit) -> $180 / 1M; 20% (6-month commit @ 500M/mo) -> $160 / 1M; additional quantization/ops optimizations modeled can hit $140 / 1M in optimistic case.

Scenario B — Dedicated (reserved capacity):
- Reserved pool effective baseline after infra savings: $135 / 1M
- Commitment/contract admin uplift: +$10 / 1M
- Net before discount: $145 / 1M
- Conservative committed discount (6-month) -> $125 / 1M (requires 500M+/mo guaranteed).

Key takeaways tailored to Stellarnet:
- To get to your $125 / 1M target, Dedicated reserved is the most direct path at your expected 300–500M baseline; Hosted can get close with a 6-month 20% commit + ops optimizations.
- For a 90-day pilot with a soft 500M/month commit we recommend Hosted with a 15% commit discount and a defined overage rate. That keeps operational overhead low and lets us tune cache & batching parameters to reduce per‑token cost.

Attachments: line-item PDF includes example invoice lines (compute hours, token processing, storage, support, one-time SOW fee). Stellarnet_token_model_v1.xlsx includes a tab that takes your monthly target and outputs estimated monthly invoice at each discount tier.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Confirm pilot band (you indicated 300–500M/mo; confirm exact target for the invoice).
2) If procurement wants a formal quote, I can generate a DocuSign with the SOW and the precise discount tied to the monthly commitment (Deal ID: STELL-2026-08-A).
3) Grace / Marcus — could you review the spreadsheet assumptions (particularly egress and cache amortization) and OK the 20% ceiling for a 6-months 500M/mo commit? I’ll hold the formal quote until you confirm.

Thanks — I’ll stand by for your preferred scenario and I can issue a formal quote by EOD PST.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Subject: INTERNAL: Quick review — Stellarnet assumptions & discount ask

Grace / Marcus — internal ask only (not to be forwarded to customer without sign-off).

Attached workbook has our working assumptions. The customer is pushing to land ~$125 / 1M. I modeled two levers to get there: quantization + runtime optimizations (ops) or moving them to Dedicated reserved with a 6-month 500M/mo commit. The customer is open to either.

Questions: 
- Can we approve a 20% commit discount (6-month, 500M/mo) for a pilot under an SOW? That gets the Dedicated net to ~$125 / 1M in our model.
- Is there any mandate from finance about minimum SOW or one-time onboarding fees we should require? I included a $15k SOW/setup fee in the PDF but can drop to $7.5k for a longer commit.

If you can skim the "discount_scenarios" tab and confirm by noon PST I’ll issue the formal quote and kick DocuSign for procurement.

Thanks,
Aditya
